scenes.narration: John holds Apple from Oakmere. He read the terms when he bought. Terms can change after that.
RWA Sonar re-reads every document it cites, every day, and checks each quoted sentence word for word.
On Tuesday night, Oakmere edits its terms. The redemption fee goes from a quarter of a percent to two percent. A new line lets Oakmere suspend redemptions at its discretion.
The next read catches it. The site keeps both versions, marks the old claim as changed, and shows the two texts side by side, dated.
A language model reads the difference and rates how much it matters to holders. Here, high impact. The rating is labelled as the model's.
Every hour, it also reads the token's keys on Solana. When the freeze key moves from a three-of-five multisig to one key, that is flagged too.
John watches his token, so both changes are in his Telegram digest the next morning.
Terms and keys can change after you buy. RWA Sonar dot com tells you when.
